Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source activities and compound_structures. Join activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1040694', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
